card.name: Daily and QD dosing terms, erythroderma
card.fires_on: The word piece 'D' in 'QD', the word 'day' or 'daily' after 'every' or 'prolonged', and 'der' inside 'erythroderma/erythrodermic'. Also 'time' in 'full-time'.

modes.label: Once-daily abbreviations
modes.description: The D of QD or the word day/daily in once-a-day dosing text.
modes.example: TID = Three times a day; BID = Two times a day; Q<<D>> = Single daily dose

modes.label: Inside erythroderma
modes.description: The 'der' piece in erythroderma or erythrodermic skin conditions.
modes.example: patients with erythro<<der>>mic psoriasis are to be classed

modes.label: Other modifiers
modes.description: Words like time or radical that follow a modifier and precede a noun.
modes.example: an individual with a full<<-time>> job at the minimum wage
